title: account_followup — AR dunning/follow-up chain L3
key_finding: account_followup is an Enterprise-only module. The entire AR dunning chain — follow-up level configuration, automated overdue detection via cron, dunning letter generation, and reconciliation-triggered flag clearing — is absent from Community 19.0. No partial implementation exists.
